title: Working memory, exploration, and cognitive development
title_zh: 工作记忆、探索与认知发展
abstract: Children tend to explore broadly, and, despite its costs, exploration confers important benefits, especially early in development, when they know little. What drives this exploratory behavior? In contrast to accounts that emphasize heightened curiosity or increased randomness, we propose that early exploration reflects the immaturity of the working memory-selective attention system.
abstract_zh: 儿童往往进行广泛探索，尽管这种行为有一定代价，但探索仍带来重要收益，尤其在早期发展阶段，当他们掌握的知识有限时更为明显。是什么驱动了这种探索行为？与强调高度好奇心或随机性增加的解释不同，我们提出：早期的探索行为反映的是工作记忆—选择性注意系统的未成熟。
